Enum Class StaticCompilationMode

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<StaticCompilationMode>
io.micronaut.python.processing.staticcompile.StaticCompilationMode
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<StaticCompilationMode>, Constable
public enum StaticCompilationMode extends Enum<StaticCompilationMode>
How much of a compilation's Python code is compiled to Java in the generated stubs.

Static compilation assumes the whole application is compiled at once: it is not meant for libraries, and a subclass defined outside the compilation (in another module or library, inside a function, or at runtime) that overrides a compiled method is not seen by Java callers, which run the compiled body of the base.

Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Graeme Rocher

  • Enum Constant Details

    • OFF

      public static final StaticCompilationMode OFF
      Nothing is compiled unless switched on by a CompileStatic decorator. The planner, and the type checker it needs, only run when a source applies such a decorator; otherwise the compilation pays nothing and no report is written.

    • ANNOTATED

      public static final StaticCompilationMode ANNOTATED
      Only the scopes carrying a CompileStatic decorator are compiled: exactly the functions OFF compiles, with the same warnings for a switch that cannot be honoured. The difference is the cost and the report: the planner and the type checker always run over every source, and the report, when a directory is configured, is always written with a decision for every function, EXCLUDED for those no switch reaches. Use it to audit a code base without changing what is compiled.

    • ALL

      public static final StaticCompilationMode ALL
      Every eligible function is compiled unless a decorator excludes it.
